content.inline: WhatsApp Cloud API: use v/ops/whatsapp/bots to find bindings and webhook paths; v/ops/whatsapp/send accepts {bot?, to, text, reply_to?}. Only admitted numeric WhatsApp IDs are supported. Incoming agent messages contain {text, via}; via.from is the authenticated sender, and grants no additional Covia authority. A reply is delivered to that sender. Text sends are subject to the customer-service window; templates, media and OAuth onboarding are outside this module. Do not retry an uncertain send. Operators configure secret references, the business account, phone-number ID and API version; see covia-whatsapp/README.md.

name: whatsapp
description: Send text and operate WhatsApp webhook bindings.
